fields.label: Audio Device
fields.description: ALSA audio input device name (e.g., 'default', 'pipewire', 'sysdefault:CARD=Pro'). Run 'arecord -L' to see all available devices.

fields.label: Sample Rate
fields.description: Audio sample rate in Hz

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Transcription model, format engine:model. parakeet:default runs locally. openai:gpt-live-transcribe streams live text (needs OPENAI_API_KEY); openai:gpt-transcribe uploads once at the end.

fields.label: Acronym Detection
fields.description: Convert letter-by-letter patterns to acronyms (e.g., 'a p i' → 'API'). ~2ms overhead.

fields.label: Capitalization
fields.description: Capitalize first word, pronoun 'I', and after sentence endings. ~5ms overhead.

fields.label: Grammar & Spell Checking
fields.description: Global switch for the grammar stage (Harper grammar and spelling). Turning it off removes the stage for every engine; which engines use it is set in the Pipeline section.

fields.label: Word Substitution
fields.description: Replace spoken phrases with desired text (e.g., 'shay moy' → 'chezmoi'). Edit ~/.local/share/voice-dictation/substitutions.txt to configure.

fields.label: Fuzzy Vocabulary Correction
fields.description: Global switch for the fuzzy_vocab stage. Snaps transcribed words onto your user dictionary (e.g. 'life md' to 'lifemd'). Turning it off removes the stage for every engine; which engines use it is set in the Pipeline section.

fields.label: Trailing Audio Buffer
fields.description: Duration in milliseconds to continue recording after stop command (captures final words that might otherwise be cut off)

fields.label: Media Resume Delay
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds before resuming paused media after recording stops

fields.label: Audio Backend
fields.description: Audio capture backend: 'auto' (prefer PipeWire, fallback to cpal), 'pipewire' (native PipeWire for mic sharing), 'cpal' (cross-platform via ALSA).

fields.label: Idle Release Timeout
fields.description: Seconds to keep microphone open after recording stops (allows fast re-start). After timeout, mic is released for other apps. Set to 0 for immediate release.

fields.label: Correction Learning
fields.description: Automatically detect when you correct transcribed text and learn from corrections. Requires AT-SPI2 accessibility bus (available by default on GNOME/KDE). ~1-2ms per injection (background monitoring).

fields.label: Correction Monitor Duration
fields.description: How many seconds to monitor for corrections after text injection.

fields.label: Auto-Promote Threshold
fields.description: Number of times a correction must be seen before it's automatically added as a word substitution rule.

fields.label: Correction Max Age
fields.description: Unpromoted corrections not seen for this many days are pruned when the daemon starts.

fields.label: wezterm Correction Backend
fields.description: Detect corrections in wezterm by polling pane text via the wezterm mux CLI (wezterm is invisible to AT-SPI2). Used automatically when dictating into wezterm. Heuristic: TUIs and multiline prompts are detected and skipped.

fields.label: Enable Accessibility Bridge
fields.description: Automatically enable the GTK/Qt accessibility bridge on daemon startup. Required for correction learning to detect text edits. Sets org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility to true via gsettings.

sections.title: Pipeline
sections.description: Post-processing stages per engine. Each engine declares the stages it needs; set a list here to override it.

fields.label: Parakeet Stages
fields.description: Stages for local Parakeet models. Declared default: acronyms, punctuation, word_substitution, fuzzy_vocab, grammar. Comma-separated stages from: acronyms, punctuation, word_substitution, fuzzy_vocab, grammar, llm_correction. 'default' uses what the engine declares; 'none' runs nothing.

fields.label: OpenAI Stages
fields.description: Stages for OpenAI models. Declared default: none, because hosted output is already punctuated and uses keywords for vocabulary. Comma-separated stages from: acronyms, punctuation, word_substitution, fuzzy_vocab, grammar, llm_correction. 'default' uses what the engine declares; 'none' runs nothing.

sections.title: OpenAI
sections.description: Settings for openai:* models. The API key comes from OPENAI_API_KEY.

fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Short description of what you usually dictate, sent as transcription context. Empty sends nothing.

fields.label: Dictionary Keywords
fields.description: Send user-dictionary words (3+ characters) as keyword hints to gpt-transcribe and gpt-live-transcribe.

fields.label: Extra Keywords
fields.description: Additional comma-separated keyword hints, sent before dictionary words. Keep the original casing, e.g. 'WorkOS, JWKS, CloudFront'.

fields.label: Languages
fields.description: Expected languages as comma-separated ISO codes, e.g. 'en'. Empty lets the model detect.

fields.label: Realtime Delay
fields.description: gpt-live-transcribe latency versus accuracy. Lower shows text sooner; higher gives the model more context.

fields.label: Realtime URL
fields.description: WebSocket endpoint for realtime transcription. If the stream fails, the utterance is transcribed once with gpt-transcribe instead.

sections.title: LLM Correction
sections.description: The llm_correction stage: an Amazon Bedrock pass over the final text that applies spoken self-corrections. Add llm_correction to a Pipeline list to use it. On any failure or timeout the text is kept unchanged.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Bedrock model id or inference-profile ARN. Empty disables the stage.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: AWS region of the model or profile.

fields.label: AWS Profile
fields.description: Profile for 'aws configure export-credentials' (SSO works). Empty uses AWS_* environment variables, then the default profile.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: Milliseconds to wait for the correction before typing the uncorrected text.
